listing.description:
# Acceleration Absorbers

![Acceleration Absorbers cover](ksa-image:cover)

Powered modules that absorb acceleration loads in Kitten Space Agency. The
in-game dashboard shows the controlled vehicle's G-forces, installed absorber
capacity, electricity use, and power-limit warnings. Requires StarMap.

Inspired by the
[Andruckabsorber](https://www.perrypedia.de/wiki/Andruckabsorber) from Perry
Rhodan.

## Parts and ratings

There are six gameplay form factors: Compact Radial, Heavy Radial, and 1 m,
2 m, 3 m, and 4 m Inline. The Heavy Radial is also available in caged and
cage-free cosmetic versions; both have identical gameplay values.

Every form factor comes in the same four maximum G ratings:

- **4 G (Green)**
- **8 G (Cyan)**
- **12 G (Amber)**
- **16 G (Violet)**

## Absorption and power limits

The G rating is the module's maximum absorption. Actual absorption depends on
the vehicle mass and requested G-load. Requested power is calculated per module:

```text
requested power = BasePower + vehicle mass (tonnes) × commanded G × k
k = PowerPerGLoad × PowerPerTonne
```

`MaxPower` caps the electrical draw. When a module reaches that cap, it
delivers less G than its rating. The table shows the cap for each rating and
form factor; power values are per module.

All variants have a **10–30 ms response delay**. This is negligible for most
builds, but during abrupt, extreme acceleration changes the unabsorbed portion
can temporarily exceed the vehicle's structural limit.

| Part | 4 G [Green] | 8 G [Cyan] | 12 G [Amber] | 16 G [Violet] |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Compact Radial | 2.5 kW | 3.325 kW | 4.175 kW | 5 kW |
| Heavy Radial | 15 kW | 19.95 kW | 25.05 kW | 30 kW |
| 1 m Inline | 5 kW | 6.65 kW | 8.35 kW | 10 kW |
| 2 m Inline | 25 kW | 33.25 kW | 41.75 kW | 50 kW |
| 3 m Inline | 80 kW | 106.4 kW | 133.6 kW | 160 kW |
| 4 m Inline | 250 kW | 332.5 kW | 417.5 kW | 500 kW |

All listed G ratings, power settings, and delay bounds are configurable per
part in its `AccelerationAbsorber` XML component.

**Balance note:** These parts were designed for much higher electricity
availability, not the current power system in KSA `2026.11.16.5901` (as of
`2026-11-19`).
